column3: “I returned and I lifted up my eyes” is rendered “I lifted up my eyes again.”
“From this according to it” is rendered “according to the writing on one side … on the other side”; NASB supplies “the writing” and adds “surely.” The meaning is uncertain.
“To falsehood” is rendered “falsely,” and “lodge” “spend the night”; “wood and stones” is rendered “timber and stones.”
“Their appearance” follows the Hebrew; the sentence continues into verse 7, and NASB adds “Again.”
NASB puts the first clause in parentheses and adds “this is”; “one woman” is rendered “a woman.”
“Wickedness” is capitalized as a name; “mouth” is rendered “opening.”
“House” is rendered “temple,” and “stand” “pedestal”; “it will be placed” is rendered “she will be set,” and NASB adds “when.”
